headline: South Africa's Astral Foods Doubles Full-Year Earnings as Poultry Feed Costs Fall
summary: Astral Foods doubled its annual headline earnings as lower feed costs boosted profitability, though high fuel prices and weather remain potential risks.
why: Astral Foods is South Africa's largest integrated poultry producer, sensitive to feed grain and energy input prices.

impacts.name: Astral Foods
impacts.why: Astral Foods doubled its full-year earnings due to easing feed costs.
